title: thelypteris bewaniensis
intro: Thelypteris bewaniensis, commonly known as Bewani shield fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is rich in medicinal properties and has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris bewaniensis include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infectious diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
